description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (1 X 2 bed and 1 X 3 bed); single and two storey side to rear extension; single storey rear extension; external alterations; separate amenity space; boundary treatment; hard and soft landscaping; bin and cycle stores
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p><span data-teams="true">Not withstanding the Biodiversity net gain plan dated 29/09/2025 prior to the completion of the development at least 1 x hedgehog box and 2 x Hedgehog holes to be fitted in the boundary fencing shall be installed on site and retained thereafter. A plan showing the location of he hedgehog box must be submitted before the commencement of the development.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">Notwithstanding the
approved details and prior to the commencement of development, full details of
the permeable paving and details relating to the long term maintenance and
management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved shall be
retained thereafter.</span></p>

<div>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and reenacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Class L in Part 3 and of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;</div><div><br></div>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted details of authority the location of a secure and sheltered cycle store, including the dimensions and external finish of the store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the forecourt of the site.&nbsp; Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities, Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken, A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works, Hard materials and Boundary Treatment Secure and screened bin and bike stores.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby by approved shall not be occupied until full details of boundary treatment including access gates, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the plan approved and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><div><br></div>

<div>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:</div><div>Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors</div><div>Hours of work</div><div>HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials and delivery hours</div><div>Number of HGV’s anticipated</div><div>Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development</div><div>Programme of work and phasing</div><div>Site layout plan</div><div>Measures to control dust and dirt during construction</div><div>A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works</div><div>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</div><div><br></div>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: reasonable exception statement, Site location Plan, Design and access statement,&nbsp;WG67-AP2-101,&nbsp;WG67-AP2-102, WG67-AP2-104, Biodiversity Net Gain Plan dated 29/09/2025, Biodiversity net gain tool, WG67-AP2-103A Rev A<font color="#0782c1">&nbsp;.</font>
